rows.label: Expo SDK 56 baseline
rows.detail: Expo 56, React 19.2.3, React Native 0.85.3, Node >=22.13.0, iOS 16.4, Android SDK 36.

rows.label: Release CI workflow
rows.detail: GitHub Actions release verification runs Node 22.13.0 with typecheck, gameplay contract, and release:verify.

rows.label: UI locale coverage
rows.detail: 10 UI locales configured from system language; Japanese UI locale omitted.

rows.label: JLPT N5-N1 study bank
rows.detail: 92 kana, 513 vocabulary, 148 original anime-style line prompts, 100 grammar prompts.

rows.label: Study bank depth audit
rows.detail: 853 items, 26 topic families, N5-N1 progression verified.

rows.label: Study content localization
rows.detail: 853 study items and 685 study text keys localized for 10 UI locales.

rows.label: Runtime assets
rows.detail: 6 PNG assets, 3 BGM tracks, and 853 offline pronunciations recorded.

rows.label: Public support/privacy/license site
rows.detail: 44 generated pages for 10 UI locales.

rows.label: Public site deploy audit
rows.detail: 44 routes plus hosting control files packaged; GitHub Pages workflow ready=yes, sitemap ready=yes, external hosting ready=yes.

rows.label: Public site hosting handoff
rows.detail: 44 routes mapped to 4 hosting options; external hosting verified=yes.

rows.label: App Store screenshots
rows.detail: 176 screenshots across default and localized iOS packs.

rows.label: App Store screenshot QA
rows.detail: 176 screenshots QA-passed across 10 localized upload packs.

rows.detail: 10 App Store locales previewed.

rows.label: App Store copy audit
rows.detail: 10/10 locales pass App Store copy, keyword, and claim checks.

rows.label: App Store metadata upload packet
rows.detail: 10/10 locales have copy-ready fields and screenshot upload packs; support URLs ready=10/10.

rows.label: Localization QA audit
rows.detail: 10 UI locales, 10 App Store locales, and 160 localized screenshots verified.

rows.label: App Store age rating audit
rows.detail: 12/12 advisory answers are NONE; final rating comes from App Store Connect.

rows.label: Open source license audit
rows.detail: 515 runtime packages checked; 0 unknown and 0 prohibited runtime licenses.

rows.label: App Store review guide
rows.detail: No demo account or sign-in required; 176 screenshot entries referenced.

rows.label: Privacy manifest audit
rows.detail: iOS privacy manifest has 4 required-reason API categories, no tracking, and no collected data.

rows.label: App Store privacy answer pack
rows.detail: NO_LIVE_ADS state documented; no-account local app practices and live-AdMob disclosure review steps ready.

rows.label: Privacy review packet
rows.detail: NO_LIVE_ADS privacy packet ready; local evidence=yes, final review confirmed=no.

rows.label: AdMob release audit
rows.detail: NO_LIVE_ADS state audited; live ads ready=no, external ad setup ready=no.

rows.label: AdMob setup handoff
rows.detail: 4 AdMob env values and 3 manual confirmations mapped; external AdMob ready=no.

rows.label: Data flow privacy audit
rows.detail: local-only storage with 0 app-owned network hits, 0 analytics SDKs, and 0 auth SDKs.

rows.label: Runtime UI flow audit
rows.detail: 22/22 runtime UI flows verified across 10 locales and 5 JLPT levels.

rows.label: Store submission input pack
rows.detail: 18 env inputs, 3 EAS production keys, 6 manual confirmations, standalone env template ready; external blockers=5.

rows.label: External TODO tracker
rows.detail: 11 external items tracked, 5 blocking, 5 final commands blocked.

rows.detail: 10 remote-service checks prepared, 3 EAS env keys tracked; external blockers=5.

rows.label: Final launch runbook
rows.detail: 9 launch phases mapped, metadata/build/submit ready=no; external blockers=5.

rows.label: EAS production preflight
rows.detail: production profile ready, submit metadata path=./store.config.js, strict gate ready=no.

rows.detail: 301 handoff files indexed with hashes; external blockers=5.
